name: Royal Titans
overview: The fight is intended to be fought by two players with a combat level of at least 90 with emphasis on gear switches; while players may solo them, the fight is much quicker with a partner. When solo, an additional player can join the instance and the fight as long as one of the Titans has not lost more than 25% of their hitpoints. Players who die or leave in the middle of the fight will be unable to re-join the fight.

The fight consists of two phases. During phase 1, both titans will roam freely around their half of the arena and perform one of 3 actions: conjure a row of flames/ice that block players' movement, summon three respective ice/fire elementals, or perform a smash attack (fully blocked with Protect from Melee). Players will use ranged and melee to attack the titans; ranging whilst not in melee distance. Magic spells of the opposite element are used to kill the elemental beings and clear the rows of flames/ice.

Phase 2 begins when one of the giants reaches 35% HP (~210 hitpoints) or less. At that point, both titans will teleport onto the arena and become static for the rest of the encounter. They will continue their stomp attack and summoning elements but will stop conjuring flame/ice rows and instead periodically cast an arena-wide spell, dealing moderate damage. This attack can be avoided by standing on the safe spot that appears 2-3 seconds before this attack. If one of the giants is killed before the other, the remaining giant will proceed to attack the players, with their melee attack now piercing protection prayers and the safe spot for their arena-wide spell being as far away as possible from them. This makes it important to defeat both giants in quick succession.
